name: DB Lateral Raise
validation_note: Bands are standard lateral-raise coaching ranges, not measured against a labelled clip. No reference footage has confirmed them.

start_cue.en: Stand tall with the weights at your sides.
start_cue.hi: Seedhe khade ho, weight haath ke bagal mein.

good.en: Good. You raised the weights to shoulder height.

almost.en: A little higher. Lift to shoulder height.
almost.hi: Thoda aur upar. Kandhe ki height tak uthao.

above.en: Not above the shoulder. Stop at shoulder height.
above.hi: Kandhe se zyada upar nahi. Kandhe tak hi ruko.

below.en: Lift higher, up to shoulder height.
below.hi: Aur upar uthao, kandhe ki height tak.

fix.en: Lift to shoulder height, no higher.
fix.hi: Kandhe ki height tak uthao, usse zyada nahi.

good.en: Good. You lowered the weights slowly.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds coming down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.

below.en: Too fast. Do not drop the weights. Count 2.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Weight girao mat. 2 tak gino.

above.en: Very slow. Keep a steady 2 seconds down.
above.hi: Bahut dheere hai. Neeche aane mein 2 second rakho.

fix.en: Too fast. Do not drop the weights. Count 2.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Weight girao mat. 2 tak gino.

good.en: Good. Both arms went up together.

almost.en: One arm is a little lower. Raise both evenly.
almost.hi: Ek haath thoda neeche hai. Dono barabar uthao.

fix.en: One arm is much lower. Raise both arms together.
fix.hi: Ek haath bahut neeche hai. Dono haath saath uthao.
